methods.name: Upper-tail p-values below 1e-16 (mcnemar.test, oneway.test, prop.trend.test, var.test) and var.test limits at large df
methods.reference: stats::mcnemar.test; stats::oneway.test; stats::prop.trend.test; stats::var.test; stats::pf(lower.tail = FALSE); stats::qbeta
quantities: var.test p as R prints it
var.test limits at df 2e7 (exact F quantile from qbeta)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md by n for statistics and limits; p-values relative only (X-17); limits at df 2e7 1e-10 relative

deviations.quantity: var.test p-value at an extreme ratio
deviations.note: R's var.test computes 1 - pf and reports 0; p2a reports pf(lower.tail = FALSE) (keys p_upper, p_two_sided_accurate), equal to R's printed value within Tol::p_value's absolute 1e-12

R's qf returns qchisq(p, df1) / df1 above df 4e5, 2.6e-4 off at df 2e7; p2a keeps the exact F quantile (statrs FisherSnedecor::inverse_cdf, within 3e-12 of qbeta's) and is pinned to qbeta (key ci_big_exact_estimate_1), not to qf (keys qf_big, ci_big_estimate_1)
